messages:
maria_pm: Quick sync — we need a rollout safety matrix for the regional priority-routing feature (Q2). Goal: gently steer traffic to cheaper variants regionally, with zero-customer-visible regressions. Proposed plan below, want quick alignment on thresholds, slices, and kill-chain.

dan_engineer: +1. I sketched an initial canary progression: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 30% -> 100% per region. Each step 30m stable window for infra metrics, 60m for quality signals.

lee_sre: We should gate on both infra (p95 latency, cpu/gpu utilization, error-rate) and safety (model-qa MRR drop, hallucination spikes). Suggest these hard-stops: error-rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency increase > 40% triggers immediate rollback for the slice.

ashley_research: For quality signals, tie to a lightweight eval set per region + shadow sampling. If semantic-quality delta > 2% (metric TBD: rouge/embedding-sim/turn-level classifier) we pause. Also recommend periodic golden prompts sampled across tenants to detect regressions quickly.

maria_pm: Good. Need to finalize the exact thresholds and who has authority to abort. Proposal: automatic rollback on infra hard-stops, product owner + oncall for quality aborts (manual within 15m), SRE can abort any slice immediately if infra degrades.

devex: Flag naming / controls: feature flag should be triple-keyed: feature.priority_routing.v{X}.region.{region}.ring.{n}. Allow per-tenant opt-out and per-account whitelists. Also add a "safety-mode" boolean to force baseline model routing.

maria_pm: Example config snippet for rollout (for ops and devex):

```
rollout:
  feature: priority_routing
  stages:
    - ring: 0.5
      duration: 30m
      gates: [infra,quality]
    - ring: 2
      duration: 30m
      gates: [infra,quality]
    - ring: 10
      duration: 60m
      gates: [infra,quality]
  fallback_policy: instant-fallback-to-baseline
  per_tenant_override: true
```

dan_engineer: We'll implement automatic prefix/KV cache warmup for each ring to avoid cold-cache spikes. Also add a per-region traffic-weight cap to prevent accidental global surges if many regions expand simultaneously.

lee_sre: Observability checklist: per-ring dashboards (latency, qps, error-rate), shadow comparison charts (baseline vs variant), alert rules with 2 levels: warning + immediate abort. Add runbook link in alerts.

maria_pm: Who owns the rollout runbook? I can draft, but need SRE + Research sign-off. Target: runbook ready before first ring.

ashley_research: I'll prepare the eval set and define the quality metric (likely embedding-sim + human-sampled signal). Will need ~5k shadow samples across regions for the initial bake.

devex: I'll add per-tenant flag UI and an admin kill-switch. Plan to expose a temporary "rollout debug" toggle for SEs to reproduce routing.

maria_pm: Decision items for this week: (1) final thresholds for infra and quality (who owns?), (2) ownership of runbook, (3) rollout calendar (region order + blackout windows), (4) naming and flag defaults. Can each owner ack?

dan_engineer: I propose infra thresholds (initial): p95 latency +25% alert, +40% abort; error-rate alert at 0.2%, abort at 0.5%; gpu mem pressure > 80% abort. Ack from eng.

lee_sre: SRE ack for abort rules and runbook ownership (oncall_handbook -> I'll be editor). We'll add a two-hour maintenance blackout per region during rollout windows.

ashley_research: Research ack. I'll send the eval artifact and an initial quality dashboard by EOD tomorrow.

devex: DevEx ack. Will create the flag and admin UI prototype; need API contract from eng by EOD.

maria_pm: Great. Final note on customer-driven asks: enterprise customers with dedicated instances get opt-in by default, but can require pre-approval. We'll list those customers in the rollout calendar.

deploy-bot: deploy:priority-routing/v1 started to canary ring 0.5 in us-west-2 (initiated by maria_pm).

maria_pm: Thanks — I'll assemble the doc and calendar, target soft launch next Tuesday. If anything changes, post updates here. :thumbsup:
